theatre4Import.xTableFieldsWithoutShippedValues: XTable-declared scalar fields absent from the bytes JSON (for example Theatre4Shop.NodeBg/EndDesc/NodeEffectUrl, Theatre4Traceback effect fields, Theatre4Activity.TalentRefreshFreeNum, Theatre4Difficulty.DistanceGroup/HpActionPoint) are omitted: TableGeneratorV2 infers no type for an all-empty column, so they would generate no property regardless, and emitting default 0 values would be authored data.

signedInt32Corrections.reason: The client table binary encodes every non-float scalar as signed int32, but tools/decode_binary_table.py read_int decodes varints unsigned (read_uint), so negative int32 values in PGR_DATA/en/bytes JSON appear as 2**32+n. XTable.lua declares no unsigned type (only int/float/string/bool/fix), so any value in [2**31,2**32) is the two's-complement view of the signed value.
signedInt32Corrections.impactIfNotCorrected: TableGeneratorV2 int.TryParse overflows on 4294967196, so the column would silently generate as string.
signedInt32Corrections.scopeVerified: Grepped every PGR_DATA/en theatre4 JSON for integers >= 2**31: exactly these 6 occurrences; theatre5/theatre6 have none.
